The cascade is an algorithm, not a vibe. When N rules match an element, the engine computes a winner in this order:
origin/importance → cascade layer → specificity → source order → inheritance → initial value
. Misunderstanding any tier produces "why isn't my style applying?" Every selector you write is a specificity budget — spend it flat.
